description: D.O. (Do Kyung-soo) performs in Kaohsiung on December 19-20 on his 2026-2027 'DAY OFF' concert tour. The tour opened with three shows at KINTEX in Goyang on October 2-4. After Kaohsiung, the schedule moves to Singapore on January 9, Hong Kong on January 16 and Manila on January 23.
title: D.O. 'DAY OFF' Concert — Kaohsiung

description: &TEAM plays Matsuyama City Auditorium in Ehime on Saturday, December 19 and Sunday, December 20, 2026. The shows are part of the 'Mark on You' concert tour, which runs from October 15, 2026 at Tokyo Garden Theater to March 27, 2027 in Miyagi. Further event details are to come.
title: &TEAM Concert Tour 'Mark on You' — Ehime

description: TOMORROW X TOGETHER play Mizuho PayPay Dome Fukuoka on December 19 and 20, 2026 on the 'STEAL THE WIND' world tour. Doors open at 3 p.m. for a 5 p.m. start on Saturday, and at 2 p.m. for a 4 p.m. start on Sunday (Japan time). Tokyo Dome follows on January 7-8, 2027.
title: TOMORROW X TOGETHER 'STEAL THE WIND' World Tour — Fukuoka

description: Fanomenon, a new festival organized by the Popular Culture Exchange Committee, runs December 2-12, 2027 at Seoul Arena in Changdong and KINTEX in Goyang. It combines concerts, an awards ceremony honoring fandoms and a cultural expo. Organizers expect 520,000 visitors.
